slides.title: More than a game.
slides.body: Basketball is where it starts. This is what E2A is really about.

slides.title: Connecting Australia and Europe
slides.body: E2A creates opportunities for Australian players to experience European basketball, develop their skills and explore international pathways.

slides.title: A different way to learn the game
slides.body: Playing and training in a new country challenges how you think, adapt and compete. That growth goes well beyond the court.

slides.title: Players. Parents. Coaches. Clubs.
slides.body: Whether you are a young player with big goals, a parent supporting the journey or a coach building a programme, E2A is here to help bridge the distance.

slides.title: Follow the journey
slides.body: Follow @e2a_basketball for breakdowns, insights and the road from Australia to Europe.
